Visa Core Rules and Visa Product and Service Rules, edition 2026-10-24, rules 4.1.23.1 to 4.1.23.11 (agentic text last updated 2026-04). An Agentic Payment Provider must enrol in Visa Intelligent Commerce and, if it uses a stored credential, get a token from Visa or an Agentic Payment Enabler (4.1.23.2). It must get cardholder consent, state the expiry of the cardholder's payment instruction and get the cardholder's acknowledgement that they are responsible for its actions (4.1.23.3). The cardholder is responsible for the provider's actions as if the cardholder initiated the transaction (4.1.23.10).
